messages:
sam: quick idea — can we add a deploy-bot flag that auto-adjusts change-window based on recent infra noise & customer traffic? e.g. shorter windows for low traffic, longer for batch-heavy windows. thinking this would reduce manual back-and-forth during releases.

maria: love the idea. what do you mean by "adjust"? percent of p50 latency increases? or scheduled calendar windows?

sam: good Q. propose a simple heuristic initially: check 5m rolling error rate + 30m traffic delta; if both low, auto set window to 30m, otherwise default 2h. allow override via --window flag.

lee: sounds reasonable. we need safety: always require explicit --canary for model-replacing deploys. also a force-fallback pin if health fails.

arya: can we implement as a hook in the deploy pipeline? i.e., deploy-bot exposes `/deploy --adaptive-window=on` and the hook returns chosen window and a dryrun plan.

deploy-bot: (bot) proposed syntax:
```
/deploy --canary --adaptive-window=on --min-window=30m --max-window=4h --fallback-pin=sha256:abc123
```
Bot will post summary and a one-click "approve" button.

maria: +1. add a smoke-test step after canary before full roll. also add `--rollout-checks=smoke:5m,latency:10m` so it's composable.

sam: sketch of rollout-checker script (very small):
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# run smoke tests against canary
curl -sS https://canary.example/health | grep OK
# collect latency samples for 10m
# if >5% errors -> exit 1
```

lee: ops concern — autoscaling events can bump traffic; tie decision to autoscaler metrics too. Also ensure we log the chosen heuristic in release notes.

arya: UI/console note — when bot posts summary include "why chosen" lines and the metric thresholds (e.g. error_rate<0.5%, traffic_delta<10%).

sam: ok I'll open a PR with the bot CLI changes + a tiny hooklet script and a release-template update. PR will include examples and a rollback example that uses pinned version.

maria: thanks. can you add a fallback command snippet we can copy into runbook? e.g.
```
# rollback to pinned release
/deploy --pin sha256:abc123 --force --window 30m
```

sam: will do. pushing to branch `deploy/adaptive-window-hooklet` today. tagging @lee @maria for review :eyes: 

lee: review when ready. also add unit tests for the decision logic.
